comments.author: fissionxmailed
comments.body_html:
Just a heads up KnightMaster and anyone else wondering. I have a Fika server setup for my friends with this running and it’s working fine with all the other mods I have setup on server (About 30 or so).

For 3.8.0 - 3.8.2 clients had trouble downloading/requesting all the needed bundle files to add it to the cache in their local SPT/user/cache. You’d need to use the Async Bundle Loader client mod to properly handle it client side. Else clients will get what looks like “freezing” when it’s the client basically trying to request all the assets it needs at once.

However one important thing to note is double check the bundle files in your mod install itself if it complains in the logs:
- For the server logs it’ll be when clients get the bundles on first launch
- For client logs it’ll be in the in-game console when you have the scope in inventory about the associated files

If you see those it’s a weird file corruption error/failed extraction when you extract the whole zip at once. Took me several trials and errors installs to figure it out.

Once you have the files being referenced/named check the files being added to cache and make sure they’re not anything unusual compared to the rest (1 kb vs +1000 kb). If you have the mod zip, go into the zip and extract out that specific bundle file, it’ll have a similar folder path like the ‘cache’ folder on a client. Take that file and replace the one that’s installed on the server in the mod’s folder. Should then “update” the file. You will need to stop your server and restart it obviously.

3.8.3 should have fixed the issues with clients downloading the bundles. I had no issues from my testing/rollout to my server (I had to remove the Async bundle loader mod on my end to get to main menu, but it should work since I talked to mod author and we narrowed it down to something with my configs. But everything else is oddly working… ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ ). I cleared out my ‘cache’ folder on my local client machine I play on several times to make sure it grabs all the files like before and had no errors. Most of my friends have able to have client auto-download the bundles with no issue. Worst case, someone who’s managed to launch to main menu grab their ‘cache’ folder and zip up for everyone else to use.

One final thing to note is if you want to use the 4 alternative scopes the mod has it seems it cannot be done client-side, has to be added to server to apply. Not an issue if Solo, but if playing with others you may want to see which they prefer before just blanket applying for everyone. Tried to see if I can have it applied locally but client keeps downloading what the server has, so assume there’s a file comparison check on “launch” for cached mod files between server and client.
